messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the Education Committee space. We will use this channel to build out our initial course catalog and certification pathways for the membership.

messages.author: elisa.duarte.100318@heathercombecreamery.example
messages.text: Glad to be here. I have drafted some basic sensory evaluation modules that we can adapt for regional workshops later this year.

messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: Thanks Tessa. Let us review those modules during our next call so we can standardize the training tier across the new chapters.

messages.author: hannah.marceau.102446@quernstonecheeseco.example
messages.text: The workshop schedule for the annual conference is shaping up nicely. We have good interest from local affineurs to lead the handling sessions.

messages.author: elisa.duarte.100318@heathercombecreamery.example
messages.text: That is great news, Lea. I will coordinate with ICF staff to lock in the room requirements before the printed program goes to press.

messages.author: ivan.navarro.102271@plumgatefarm.example
messages.text: With all the cancellations, we need to pivot our training materials to an online format quickly. I can help record the rind-care demonstrations from our cellars.

messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: Thanks Dev, that venue logistics task for the workshop has been marked complete since we are moving entirely digital for now.

messages.author: elisa.duarte.100318@heathercombecreamery.example
messages.text: The virtual symposium attendance numbers look strong. Members seem receptive to the online credentials, though everyone is eager to return to in-person tastings.

messages.author: cedric.janvier.101224@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Venue logistics for the return conference are proving a bit strained given the surge in entries, but we are managing the classroom capacities.

messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: I have prepared the budget figures for next quarter. We need to allocate extra support for the updated affineur certification tracks.

messages.author: elisa.duarte.100318@heathercombecreamery.example
messages.text: We still need to review the member feedback digest regarding the advanced milk science modules.

messages.author: ishita.kaur.100472@cindervalefinecheese.example
messages.text: The latest meeting summary has been circulated to all committee members. Please let me know if any corrections are needed.

messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: We have finished following up with our conference speaker candidates. The lineup for the autumn seminar series is officially locked in.

messages.author: elisa.duarte.100318@heathercombecreamery.example
messages.text: Given the cost inflation hitting our smaller makers, we should discuss offering discounted registration rates for the upcoming certification courses.

messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: That is a wise adjustment, Tessa. Let us coordinate with ICF staff to see how our hardship fund can absorb some of those training costs.

messages.author: elisa.duarte.100318@heathercombecreamery.example
messages.text: I am reviewing the latest member feedback digest now. The feedback on the modernized raw-milk aging guidelines is overwhelmingly positive.

messages.author: ashley.ackerley.100143@quillpost.example
messages.text: That is wonderful to hear, as traceability and safety standards are our main focus for the autumn curriculum update.

messages.author: cedric.janvier.101224@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Operations have really stabilized this year, and the next generation of cheesemakers is engaging heavily with our succession planning workshops.
